data.one_liner: Multi-platform Dart SDK for PocketBase open-source backend
data.what_it_does: Provides a client SDK to communicate with the PocketBase backend, supporting authentication, CRUD record operations, file uploads, realtime subscriptions, and custom SQL/collection administration tools.
use_when: You are using PocketBase as your application's backend
You need real-time data synchronization with your database
You want built-in authentication and file upload handling
avoid_when: You are using a different BaaS such as Firebase or Supabase
You do not use PocketBase or need a relational client like standard SQL/ORM drivers
strengths: Official multi-platform SDK supporting Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
Built-in support for realtime updates and robust authentication options including OAuth2 and OTP
Convenient helpers for filtering, file uploads, and optional HTTP client connection reuse
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the PocketBase backend server implementation
Requires careful setup on Android 15+ or dual-stack networks for certain OAuth2 flows due to OS restrictions
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency with 'dart pub add pocketbase' or 'flutter pub add pocketbase', and initialize the client instance with your PocketBase server URL.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer Supabase over PocketBase as your open-source backend.

alternatives.name: gotrue
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you only need GoTrue authentication without the full PocketBase ecosystem.
